base: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME SPRITE ATLAS. Image 1 is approved style and camera reference ONLY. Make a landscape 2048x1536 atlas with EXACT 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, 12 separate isolated complete buildings, one centered in each invisible grid cell. Generous fully blank gutters: content must stay 70 pixels away from every cell edge. No grid lines. Genuine TRANSPARENT background and empty space with alpha, no scene ground or terrain and no cast shadows outside footprint. Consistent isometric 3/4 view from above, same as reference. Chunky charming polished cartoon military apocalypse survival art, crisp dark outlines, bright teal panels, warm white concrete, army green tarps, yellow safety accents, patchwork armor, orange rust, worn repairs. No people, NO TEXT, NO letters or numbers, NO UI, NO labels. Each building on its own tiny foundation only, with all accessories attached and fully contained. Exact ordered subject placement, left to right: row1: 1 headquarters two-story teal concrete squat command building with one large roof satellite dish and antenna, 2 power station with three copper coils connected by black cables and blue generator units and tiny solar panels, 3 communications center compact teal-white bunker with huge dish and tall antenna tower, 4 medical station small white red-cross roof clinic flanked by green medical tents. Row2: 5 munitions factory squat dark foundry with three tall yellow-striped smokestacks and attached crates, 6 research lab squat white-teal bunker topped by bright blue segmented glass hemisphere, 7 barracks made of TWO parallel olive cargo containers with small stairs as a single sprite, 8 armory reinforced square workshop with blue wall panel and white wrench emblem roof supply crates. Row3: 9 drone hangar open rectangular teal-white garage with small grounded quadcopter inside, 10 warehouse broad squat olive storage depot tarped roof and attached crates, 11 vehicle garage white-teal open garage with olive military jeep half parked inside, 12 salvage workshop compact open yard with yellow excavator crane arm and stacked tires and scrap within its square footprint. Make all 12 large and legible, clear distinct silhouettes, uniform camera angle, grounded scrappy tone.
